origins.source: basic cohort rows of run 20260906T195728Z (a row exists if the player appeared in t or t-1)

low_production.rule: DG-179 championship-window points in the origin season (authoritative; absent row = 0 under the artifact zero convention) below the position starter line
low_production.starter_slots_meaning: 12-team starting-lineup scenario for this league's slots (QB+SF, 2 RB, 2 WR, TE, 2 FLEX); a declared scenario
low_production.deep_roster_line_meaning: DG-165 deep-roster relevance counts, NOT starting-lineup cutoffs; reported as a named sensitivity

developmental.primary: observed_history_seasons <= 3, where observed_history_seasons = seasons_played = stat-row seasons observed since 2005 at the origin; this is an OBSERVED-HISTORY stratum, explicitly not NFL experience
developmental.alternative_stratum: nfl_years_since_draft <= 3 for players with a verified draft season <= origin (drafted only; undrafted are outside this stratum and reported separately)

outcome.points: DG-179 championship-window points in origin + horizon
outcome.contributor: realized points >= the realized starter line of that later season (same slots and multiplier as the origin line)
outcome.deep_roster_contributor: realized points >= the realized deep-roster line of that later season
outcome.cumulative: contributor in any of years 1-3 (origins <= 2022 only)

current_production.primary: origin_window_points (DG-179, same window as the target)
sensitivity: total_points_t (all games incl. postseason, the model feature)

orderings.draft_capital: overall pick ascending; undrafted and not-yet-visible picks after all drafted, sharing one average rank; only draft season <= origin is visible

metrics.cells: origin season x position x horizon; pooled weighted by n
metrics.budget_meaning: a declared bench-stash scenario, not David's optimal allocation
metrics.ties: average ranks; boundary ties get fractional credit and are counted

uncertainty.method: paired player-cluster bootstrap of ordering differences (a player's origins and horizons move as one block)

disclosures: cells with fewer rows than slots

claims_not_made: waiver or availability backtest (no point-in-time ownership source): this is a historical low-production candidate screen
